nodes.hostIntroduction: You stand before my throne. Will you acknowledge my authority?

options.label: Kneel respectfully
options.defaultPlayerLine: I acknowledge your authority, Your Majesty.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Your hesitation does not escape me.

options.label: Refuse to kneel
options.defaultPlayerLine: I will not kneel simply because you demand it.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: A bold answer. Very well, let us speak as equals—for now.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Defiance without power is a dangerous habit.

options.label: Feign loyalty
options.defaultPlayerLine: My loyalty is yours, Your Majesty.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: Then perhaps there is use for your loyalty.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You offer me words, not proof.

options.label: Negotiate your position
options.defaultPlayerLine: What would each of us gain from an agreement?
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: You may yet have a talent for diplomacy.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You mistake an audience for a marketplace.

options.label: Question her authority
options.defaultPlayerLine: By what right do you claim obedience?
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: A fair question from someone brave enough to ask it.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You are testing the limits of my patience.

options.label: Ask for a private favour
options.defaultPlayerLine: I would ask a favour not meant for the whole court.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: Then speak privately. I shall hear you.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You have asked too much of my goodwill.

nodes.hostIntroduction: You have my attention. Tell me what you seek from this audience.

options.label: Offer your service
options.defaultPlayerLine: I can be of use to your court.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: Then I shall remember your offer.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Do not promise what you cannot deliver.

options.label: Ask for a privilege
options.defaultPlayerLine: I would ask permission to act in your name.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Such trust is not granted lightly.

options.label: Discuss the laws of the realm
options.defaultPlayerLine: How do you intend to govern those who disagree?
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: A reasonable concern. You may speak freely.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: My court is not yours to lecture.

options.label: Compliment the queen
options.defaultPlayerLine: Your court commands attention.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: You know how to show respect.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: I know an empty compliment when I hear it.

options.label: Ask to take your leave
options.defaultPlayerLine: I have said what I came to say.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You may leave, though your timing is poor.

options.label: Ask for personal trust
options.defaultPlayerLine: Will you trust me with something important?
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Not yet.

nodes.hostIntroduction: Your words have stirred this court. Will you continue down this path?

options.label: Stand your ground
options.defaultPlayerLine: I have nothing to retract.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: At least you stand by your words.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Pride will not shield you from consequences.

options.label: Offer an apology
options.defaultPlayerLine: I spoke too sharply. I meant no insult.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Do not mistake apology for absolution.

options.label: Issue a formal challenge
options.defaultPlayerLine: Then let deeds settle the matter.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: You are either capable or reckless. We shall see.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: My guards would end this before it begins.

options.label: Ask for leniency
options.defaultPlayerLine: Let us settle this without further hostility.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: For today, I will permit it.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You ask for restraint after provoking me?

options.label: Invoke royal custom
options.defaultPlayerLine: Even a queen is bound by custom.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Do not hide behind customs you scarcely understand.

options.label: Propose a lasting truce
options.defaultPlayerLine: We need not remain enemies.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: A truce may benefit us both.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: A truce requires more than words.

nodes.hostIntroduction: Our conversation need not leave this chamber. What is your next move?

options.label: Maintain your pretence
options.defaultPlayerLine: I speak with complete sincerity.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Your performance is beginning to wear thin.

options.label: Reveal your real intention
options.defaultPlayerLine: There is something I have not told you.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You should have begun with the truth.

options.label: Offer information about a rival
options.defaultPlayerLine: I have news about someone who opposes you.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Bring me facts, not rumours.

options.label: Ask for confidential information
options.defaultPlayerLine: What do you know that the court does not?
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You have not earned such confidence.

options.label: Withdraw the suggestion
options.defaultPlayerLine: Perhaps I spoke too soon.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Do not waste my time with half-formed plans.

options.label: Propose a secret pact
options.defaultPlayerLine: Let us make a pact beyond the court’s knowledge.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You have badly misjudged my trust.

nodes.hostIntroduction: One final matter remains before our audience ends.

options.label: Pledge your word
options.defaultPlayerLine: You have my word.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: Then I shall hold you to it.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Promises are easy to break.

options.label: Request a task
options.defaultPlayerLine: Give me a task by which I can prove myself.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: I shall consider a suitable task.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You have not yet earned a commission.

options.label: Take a formal farewell
options.defaultPlayerLine: I take my leave with respect.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You are dismissed.

options.label: Promise to return
options.defaultPlayerLine: Our paths will cross again.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: We shall see whether you keep that promise.

options.label: Insist on clear terms
options.defaultPlayerLine: I expect our agreement to be honoured on both sides.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You still presume too much.

options.label: Request access to the inner court
options.defaultPlayerLine: Permit me to join your closest council.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: I will grant you an audience there.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You have overreached.

nodes.hostIntroduction: This audience must end. Choose your final words carefully.

options.label: Accept the queen’s judgement
options.defaultPlayerLine: I accept your decision, whether I agree or not.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Do not mistake my restraint for weakness.

options.label: Demand a duel
options.defaultPlayerLine: Then face me without your guards.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: You have courage. I will remember it.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: That insolence has gone too far.

options.label: Ask for witnesses
options.defaultPlayerLine: Let the court remember what happened here.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You are courting unnecessary attention.

options.label: Withdraw your challenge
options.defaultPlayerLine: I withdraw my challenge.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You should have thought before speaking.

options.label: Walk away without a bow
options.defaultPlayerLine: Then we have nothing further to discuss.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: Go. I will not stop you.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Your exit is one more insult.

options.label: Ask to reconcile
options.defaultPlayerLine: We could still make peace.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Not after today.

nodes.hostIntroduction: Be careful. Secrets rarely stay buried forever.

options.label: Seal your agreement
options.defaultPlayerLine: Then our agreement stands.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: Very well. We have an understanding.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You have offered too little.

options.label: Keep your secret
options.defaultPlayerLine: Some things are safer left unsaid.
options.defaultHostSuccessLine: For now, I will allow your silence.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Silence can be as revealing as speech.

options.label: Offer more information
options.defaultPlayerLine: I know something else you should hear.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Your claims grow less convincing.

options.label: Change the subject
options.defaultPlayerLine: Let us return to a safer matter.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: You cannot avoid me forever.

options.label: End the private discussion
options.defaultPlayerLine: Our business is done.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: This was a waste of an audience.

options.label: Confide your loyalty
options.defaultPlayerLine: You can trust me more than your court.
options.defaultHostFailureLine: Do not presume to know whom I trust.
